headline: Duke ends UNCW's unbeaten season
dek: UNCW had won fifteen matches and drawn seven before its one defeat of the season, leaving no unbeaten program in the conference. With 52 goals scored against twenty conceded, it still outscored every other side in the CAA.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Goals scored do not order the table: Hampton, at its foot, has scored more across all its matches than Hofstra, which trails only UNCW and Towson.

wire.line: No unbeaten program remains in the conference after UNCW fell at Duke.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches are past their date with no result, one for Elon and one for William & Mary, both from the season's first week.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fifteen different players have scored for Elon this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Northeastern's Eliza Teplow has made 97 saves at a .808 save percentage.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tallulah Miller has kept seven shutouts for Monmouth.

last_match.line: Duke is the only opponent to beat UNCW this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
